# Tema Theme

## Continuous Development for Sustaining Growth

Pengembangan Berkesinambungan untuk Mendukung Pertumbuhan Berkelanjutan

![img-1.jpeg](img-1.jpeg)

Perseroan membangun budaya keberlanjutan dengan pelatihan, pengembangan, dan kerja sama untuk menumbuhkan kesadaran bagi setiap insan Wismilak. Sepanjang 2025, Perseroan mengarahkan fokus pada penguatan strategi, peningkatan nilai tambah dari setiap inisiatif, serta optimalisasi kinerja operasional. Di tengah dinamika usaha yang cepat berubah, proses bisnis membutuhkan inovasi dan peningkatan kapabilitas sumber daya manusia, serta kinerja operasional yang lebih efisien dan adaptif. Dengan demikian, keseimbangan pengelolaan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola menjadi landasan dalam setiap pengambilan keputusan dan kesinambungan pertumbuhan usaha, sekaligus memperkuat daya saing usaha.

The Company fosters a sustainability culture through training, development, and collaboration to raise awareness among all Wismilak employees. Throughout 2025, the Company focused on strengthening its strategy, enhancing the value creation of each initiative, and optimizing operational performance. Amid rapidly changing business dynamics, business processes require continuous innovation, enhanced human capital capabilities, and operational performance that is more efficient and adaptive. Accordingly, a balanced approach to managing environmental, social, and governance aspects serves as the foundation for decision-making and the sustainability of business growth, while also strengthening the Company's competitiveness.

## Message from the President Director

![img-32.jpeg](img-32.jpeg)

“Keberlanjutan merupakan proses yang terus kami jalankan sesuai komitmen Wismilak dalam melakukan praktik usaha berkelanjutan serta membawa dampak positif bagi masyarakat, lingkungan, dan masa depan. Sepanjang 2025, Wismilak terus mendorong inovasi, memperkuat kapabilitas sumber daya manusia, dan meningkatkan efisiensi operasional untuk mendukung pertumbuhan usaha yang lebih tangguh, adaptif, dan berdaya saing.”

Sustainability is an ongoing process that we continue to pursue in line with Wismilak's commitment to implementing sustainable business practices and creating a positive impact on society, the environment, and the future. Throughout 2025, Wismilak continued to drive innovation, strengthen human capital capabilities, and improve operational efficiency to support business growth that is more resilient, adaptive, and competitive.

# Para Pemangku Kepentingan yang Terhormat, Dear Stakeholders,

Di tengah dinamika industri dan kondisi ekonomi sepanjang 2025, Wismilak terus meningkatkan kesadaran untuk menerapkan prinsip keberlanjutan dalam menjalankan strategi bisnis. Langkah ini kami perkuat dengan mempertajam fokus kami pada inovasi dan kolaborasi. Kami terus melakukan integrasi antar fungsi untuk memperkuat sinergi pengelolaan kinerja lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (ESG), serta meneruskan pengukuran dampak kegiatannya secara bertahap.

Amid industry dynamics and economic conditions throughout 2025, Wismilak continued to strengthen its commitment to implementing sustainability principles in executing its business strategy. We reinforced this effort by sharpening our focus on innovation and collaboration. We continue to integrate functions across the organization to strengthen the synergy of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance management, while gradually continuing to measure the impacts of these activities.

# Strategi Keberlanjutan dan Kebijakan Merespons Tantangan
## Sustainability Strategy and Policy in Responding to Challenges

Transformasi keberlanjutan dalam dunia usaha mendorong Wismilak untuk terus memperkuat komitmen terhadap pengelolaan ESG. Dengan berpegang pada nilai Bersama Meraih Sukses, Memiliki Integritas, dan Semangat Continuous Improvement, Perseroan berupaya memastikan bahwa setiap kegiatan operasional dilakukan secara bertanggung jawab dan memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.

The sustainability transformation taking place in the business world has encouraged Wismilak to continuously strengthen its commitment to ESG management. Guided by the values of Achieving Success Together, Upholding Integrity, and Maintaining a Spirit of Continuous Improvement, the Company strives to ensure that every operational activity is carried out responsibly and delivers benefits to society and the environment.

Tahun 2025 diwarnai oleh berbagai dinamika yang meningkatkan risiko operasional kami. Ketidakpastian kondisi iklim menjadi salah satu faktor yang berdampak pada stabilitas rantai pasok bahan baku. # Penentuan Topik Material[1-1][1-2] Material Topics Determination

Wismilak melakukan peninjauan topik material setiap tahun guna memastikan prospek bisnis, strategi, dan inisiatif keberlanjutannya tetap selaras dengan kebutuhan dan ekspektasi pemangku kepentingan. Perseroan melakukan Identifikasi risiko, peluang, strategi usaha, dan menganalisis dampaknya. Dalam proses tersebut, Perseroan juga mempertimbangkan acuan topik material yang tercantum dalam standar GRI dan International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

Pada 2025, Wismilak memperkuat proses penilaian materialitas dengan menerapkan pendekatan double materiality (DMA). Pendekatan dianalisis melalui materialitas dampak (impact materiality) yang memerhatikan dampak aktivitas Perseroan terhadap lingkungan dan sosial, serta materialitas finansial (financial materiality) yang memetakan dampak kinerja ESG terhadap kondisi keuangan. Topik material dirumuskan ulang melalui diskusi internal yang dipandu oleh tim akademisi selaku pihak independen dan tim ahli. Proses ini melibatkan perwakilan dari berbagai fungsi di Wismilak. Pelaksanaan diskusi tetap mempertimbangkan masukan dari pemangku kepentingan internal dan eksternal. Hasil diskusi tersebut kemudian diajukan kepada Direksi dan telah memperoleh pengesahan serta penetapan.

# Topik Material [1-2] Material Topics

Setelah disetujui Direksi, Laporan Keberlanjutan Wismilak 2025 mengungkapkan enam topik material sebagai prioritas pengungkapan informasi. Dengan demikian, terdapat perubahan atas topik material yang disampaikan pada Laporan Keberlanjutan periode sebelumnya. Perubahan tersebut dipengaruhi oleh perbedaan metode penentuan topik material serta isu-isu keberlanjutan yang berkembang selama 2025.

Wismilak reviews its material topics annually to ensure that its business prospects, strategy, and sustainability initiatives remain aligned with stakeholder needs and expectations. The Company identifies risks, opportunities, and business strategies, and analyzes their impacts. In this process, the Company also considers references to material topics set out in the GRI Standards and the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

In 2025, Wismilak strengthened its materiality assessment process by adopting a double materiality approach (DMA). Under this framework, the Company assessed impact materiality, which considers the effects of its activities on the environment and society, alongside financial materiality, which evaluates the influence of ESG performance on its financial condition. The material topics were subsequently refined through internal discussions facilitated by an independent academic team, with support from a team of experts. Representatives from various functions across Wismilak participated in the process, which also incorporated input from both internal and external stakeholders. The results of the discussion were subsequently submitted to the Board of Directors and have obtained approval and formal endorsement.

Following approval by the Board of Directors, the 2025 Wismilak Sustainability Report discloses six material topics as disclosure priorities. Accordingly, there were changes to the material topics presented in the previous reporting period's Sustainability Report. These changes were influenced by differences in the method used to determine material topics, as well as sustainability issues that developed during 2025.

# Wismilak Mendukung Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB)
Wismilak's Support for the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

Perseroan mendukung TPB yang relevan dan menjadi prioritas dalam implementasi kinerja keberlanjutan. Proses identifikasi tersebut mengacu pada indikator dan target yang tercantum dalam Metadata Indikator TPB yang diterbitkan oleh Kementerian PPN/Bappenas.

Dalam penerapannya, Perseroan menggunakan SDG Compass dengan tahapan berikut:

The Company supported the SDGs that were relevant and prioritized in the implementation of its sustainability performance. The identification process referred to the indicators and targets set out in the SDGs Indicator Metadata issued by the Ministry of National Development Planning/Bappenas.

In its implementation, the Company used the SDG Compass through the following stages:

1. **Memahami TPB**
Dukungan terhadap TPB menjadi tanggung jawab moral seluruh pelaku usaha. Oleh karena itu, Perseroan memahami bahwa kontribusi terhadap TPB perlu selaras dengan upaya mitigasi risiko, pemanfaatan peluang, serta strategi bisnis yang dijalankan.

Seiring perubahan perilaku konsumen yang mempengaruhi tingkat konsumsi domestik, Wismilak menghadapi tantangan dalam menjaga kinerja usaha di industri tembakau. # Dampak Perubahan Iklim [201-2] Climate Change Impacts

Perseroan mengidentifikasi perubahan iklim ekstrem sebagai risiko yang berpotensi mempengaruhi proses produksi serta ketersediaan bahan baku utama, termasuk tembakau dan cengkeh, yang dapat berdampak pada kinerja operasional dan keuangan. Untuk mengelola risiko tersebut, Perseroan menerapkan strategi pengelolaan bahan baku yang terintegrasi dengan Fungsi Manajemen Risiko, termasuk pengendalian pasokan dan mutu bahan baku.

Hingga 2025, Perseroan tidak mencatat dampak keuangan yang signifikan akibat perubahan iklim terhadap kegiatan operasional. Ke depan, Perseroan akan terus menerapkan proses produksi ramah lingkungan serta memastikan penggunaan bahan baku berkualitas melalui pengendalian mutu sesuai standar yang ditetapkan.

As consumer behavior shifts and affects the level of domestic consumption, Wismilak faces challenges in maintaining business performance in the tobacco industry. These changes have prompted the Company to adjust its business and operational strategies to remain aligned with market preferences, as well as regulatory and social developments.

In response, the Company strengthened its business strategy through the management of operational impacts, the development of community programs, and improvements in product quality and distribution effectiveness. Throughout 2025, the Company also adopted a precautionary approach and expanded collaboration with stakeholders. This approach supported business resilience and competitiveness amid changing consumption patterns and market conditions.

The Company identified extreme climate change as a risk that may affect production processes and the availability of key raw materials, including tobacco and cloves, which may in turn affect operational and financial performance. To manage this risk, the Company implemented a raw material management strategy integrated with the Risk Management Function, including controls over raw material supply and quality.

As of 2025, the Company had not recorded any significant financial impact from climate change on its operations. Going forward, the Company will continue to adopt environmentally friendly production processes and ensure the use of quality raw materials through quality control in accordance with established standards.

## Perhitungan Emisi GRK [F11] Calculation of GHG Emissions

Perseroan secara rutin melakukan pemantauan dan pelaporan emisi GRK kepada Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup sebagai bentuk kepatuhan terhadap regulasi yang berlaku. Perhitungan emisi GRK untuk PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk diklasifikasikan ke dalam cakupan 1, cakupan 2, dan cakupan 3. Emisi langsung (cakupan 1) berasal dari kegiatan operasional, termasuk penggunaan kendaraan. Emisi tidak langsung (cakupan 2) bersumber dari konsumsi energi yang dibeli, seperti listrik dari PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara (PLN) dan energi dari PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (PGN), sedangkan emisi tidak langsung lainnya (cakupan 3) berasal dari aktivitas dalam rantai pasokan pihak ketiga. Sementara itu, PT Gelora Djaja saat ini melakukan perhitungan emisi GRK dalam bentuk gabungan cakupan 1 dan cakupan 2, yang mencakup emisi $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, $\mathrm{CH}_4$, dan $\mathrm{N}_2\mathrm{O}$ dari kegiatan operasional boiler dan konsumsi listrik. Perhitungan tersebut belum dipisahkan secara rinci antara cakupan 1 dan cakupan 2. Hingga akhir tahun 2025, Perseroan juga belum melakukan perhitungan emisi zat perusak ozon (ODS) dan emisi udara signifikan lainnya. [305-6] [305-7]

This second-phase development remained focused on the Wismilak Filter business unit. The solar power system (PLTS) supports the operation of production machinery and, overall, contributes to an emissions reduction of $186\mathrm{tCO}_{2}\mathrm{e}$. Going forward, the Company also plans to expand the use of PLTS to its other business units.

The Company routinely monitors and reports its GHG emissions to the Ministry of Environment as part of its compliance with applicable regulations. GHG emissions for PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk are classified into Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3. Direct emissions (Scope 1) arise from operational activities, including vehicle use. Indirect emissions (Scope 2) originate from purchased energy consumption, such as electricity from PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara (PLN) and energy from PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (PGN), while other indirect emissions (Scope 3) derive from activities within the third-party supply chain. Meanwhile, PT Gelora Djaja currently calculates its GHG emissions as a combined total of Scope 1 and Scope 2, covering $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, $\mathrm{CH}_4$, and $\mathrm{N}_2\mathrm{O}$ emissions from boiler operations and electricity consumption. These emissions have not yet been separately disclosed between Scope 1 and Scope 2. As of the end of 2025, the Company has not yet calculated emissions of ozone-depleting substances (ODS) or other significant air emissions. [305-6][305-7]

Penerapan sistem ini juga mencerminkan kepatuhan Perseroan terhadap regulasi yang berlaku. The Company provides a decent and safe working environment for all employees, as this is an important aspect of supporting operational activities. To this end, the Company implements an Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS) to control the risk of workplace accidents, injuries, and health problems related to operational activities. The implementation of this system also reflects the Company's compliance with applicable regulations. Provisions on the OHSMS are set out in the Collective Labor Agreement (CLA) of PT Gelora Djaja and the Company Regulations of PT Gawih Jaya and PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk, with implementation covering all employees.

Tata kelola keberlanjutan Wismilak dijalankan dengan mengacu pada prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik (GCG). # SKT Wismilak Kretek Slim Klik

Perseroan melihat bahwa ruang inovasi pada segmen Sigaret Kretek Tangan (SKT) masih sangat luas untuk dikembangkan. Melalui pemahaman terhadap dinamika pasar, Perseroan menghadirkan SKT Slim Klik sebagai salah satu inovasi produk yang dirancang untuk merespons kebutuhan konsumen yang terus berkembang. Produk ini hadir sebagai jawaban atas perubahan preferensi pasar, khususnya di kalangan konsumen yang saat ini semakin menyukai rokok dengan varian rasa.

Inovasi SKT Slim Klik juga lahir dari gagasan internal Perseroan melalui ajang Quality Control Competition (QCC) yang secara rutin diselenggarakan untuk mendorong kreativitas dan inovasi karyawan di seluruh rantai nilai Perseroan. Kompetisi ini menjadi wadah bagi insan Perseroan untuk menghadirkan ide-ide pengembangan produk, proses, maupun teknologi yang dapat meningkatkan daya saing Perseroan.

SKT Slim Klik merupakan inovasi yang mencakup tiga aspek sekaligus, yaitu produk, proses, dan alat insersi kapsul, yang seluruhnya telah memperoleh paten. Melalui inovasi tersebut, Perseroan menghadirkan pengalaman baru bagi konsumen melalui produk SKT yang lebih modern dengan varian rasa yang beragam. SKT Slim Klik hadir dalam tiga varian rasa, yaitu berry tea, ice tea, dan lychee tea.

The Company sees significant room for innovation in the SKT segment. Through its understanding of market dynamics, the Company introduced SKT Slim Klik as one of its product innovations designed to respond to evolving consumer needs. This product was introduced as a response to changing market preferences, particularly among consumers who are increasingly interested in cigarettes with flavor variants.

The Hand-rolled Kretek (SKT) Slim Klik innovation also originated from the Company's internal ideas through the Quality Control Competition (QCC), which is regularly held to encourage employee creativity and innovation across the Company's value chain. This competition serves as a platform for Company personnel to present ideas for product, process, and technology development that can enhance the Company's competitiveness.

SKT Slim Klik is an innovation that covers three aspects at once, namely the product, the process, and the capsule insertion device, all of which have received patents. Through this innovation, the Company offers a new consumer experience through a more modern SKT product with a variety of flavor options.
